comparison.objective: Candidate fractures four installed HELICOIL tangs and recovers the fragments; record fits and tightens a doll’s multi-route car-seat harness.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial mandrel stabilization, controlled hammer impacts, and tiny-fragment recovery; record requires webbing routing, buckling, untwisting, and tension adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four notch fractures, four contained tangs, undamaged retained inserts/shell, released tools, and stability; record requires correctly routed untwisted webbing, measured adjustment, and a one-second hold.
comparison.reason: Harness routing and tensioning test a meaningfully different ability from impact fracture and fragment recovery.
